callPathReview.path: fixed Connection proxy open -> setAutoCommit(false) returns
getAutoCommit false -> scalar validowner/now/limit -> SQL binds -> result.next false -> List.copyOf empty; no read/requireValue
result/statement close unconditional -> commit returns -> connection close unconditional; rollback also unconditional in any assertion error
empty list -> no sender/mark -> OutboxDispatchReport(0,0,0,0) -> normal run return
no callback wait; parent5s latch bounded; finallyclose wakes own monitor and joins only own worker; no external lifetime/resource

finding.message: Ensure that resources like this PrintStream object are closed after use

staticClassifications.reason: ByteArrayOutputStream is only a memory sink; owning PrintStream uses TWR and closes it even on assertion failure, System.err is restored in outer finally.

finding.message: Ensure that resources like this OwnedOutboxDispatcher object are closed after use

staticClassifications.reason: Unstarted OwnedOutboxDispatcher is closed immediately and twice, then restart rejection/health are the actual oracle. No worker starts before the first close; use-after-close is an intentional state assertion, not a reopened resource.

finding.message: In J2EE, getClassLoader() might not work as expected. Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead.

staticClassifications.reason: Proxy for fixed java.sql API interface only; its declaring module loader is required for visibility. No untrusted name, context-loader changes, downloaded classes, provider discovery or driver loading.

finding.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation

staticClassifications.reason: Each EmptyClaim and parameter HashMap is confined to the one owned worker; parent reads only after owned.close joins it. ConcurrentLinkedQueue publishes claims, and latch plus final join publishes all writes. No concurrent map read or mutation.
